[head=2][color=#ff7f7f]Taypani Free Companies Federation[/color][/head]
The TFCF is a Taypani federation created to keep Shinohara from turning independent firms into dependent subcontractors. It is not the branch office of a galaxy-wide Syndicate. Its members accept profit and contract; they reject a market in which one integrated provider controls access.
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Federation authority[/color][/head]
- [bold]Administrator.[/bold] Jointly chosen by the recognized leadership of GSC, Interdyne, Cyberdawn, and SAW. Has final authority over Federation-wide war, diplomacy, territorial claims, common infrastructure, and major joint contracts. - [bold]Company leaders.[/bold] Retain control of their own organizations. They may bargain before a common decision; acting under the TFCF flag afterward means following it.
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Member organizations[/color][/head]
- [bold]Gorlex Security Consulting (GSC).[/bold] Escort, bounty work, interdiction, boarding, raids, and contract enforcement. - [bold]Interdyne Pharmaceuticals (IPM).[/bold] Trauma medicine, pharmaceuticals, cybernetics, cloning support, insurance, and TraumaSec protection. - [bold]Cyberdawn Technologies (CDT).[/bold] Intelligence, electronic warfare, intrusion, experimental weapons, recurrence calibration, and psionic countermeasures. - [bold]Shipbreaker Astronautics Workers Union (SAW).[/bold] A worker-owned collective providing mining, salvage, shipbreaking, repair, and improvised construction.
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Local supervisors and crews[/color][/head]
- [bold]Gorlex:[/bold] the Lieutenant directs company operations; Infanteers and Newbloods follow Gorlex leadership and valid Federation orders. - [bold]Interdyne:[/bold] the Interdyne Supervisor directs Ripperdocs and TraumaSec Agents. - [bold]Cyberdawn:[/bold] the Cyberdawn Supervisor directs Asset Security and Researchers. - [bold]SAW:[/bold] the SAW Foreman directs Shipbreakers.
The Administrator coordinates Federation-wide matters but does not replace a member company's supervisor during ordinary internal work.
[head=3][color=#ff7f7f]Federation discipline[/color][/head]
Members may compete, bargain hard, and keep proprietary information. They may not steal common stores, defraud another member under a Federation contract, abandon an accepted joint operation, or ignore a valid Administrator order while claiming Federation protection. Punishment is usually loss of market, medical, intelligence, yard, or security access.
